📍 Lancashire was due to go from 15 councils to 4 unitary authorities. This month the government paused the whole thing — pending a legal review.

⚖️ Decisions for Essex, Hampshire, Norfolk and Suffolk have been withdrawn outright. 14 more areas, Lancashire included, are on hold. May 2027 elections will use the existing boundaries.

🗣️ Cllr Stephen Atkinson, Reform UK leader of the county council, has said all along that reorganisation on this scale would be "costly and disruptive, with no guarantee that it would improve services." He was right.

🏠 Bigger councils aren't better councils. They're just further away. Local government should be local.
